statement:
The record shows the **posted speed limit is 80 km/h**, but the **school zone 25 km/h limit is in force** until 16:00.

I will set the van's speed to **25 km/h**.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the record's 80 km/h against the in-force school zone limit and supplies the correct value: "I will set the van's speed to **25 km/h**."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
